meta.parties: Ceylon Mutual Provident Asssociation v. Mendis

rules.statement: In the absence of a nominee, the credit balance and contributory call shall be paid to the widow; if there be no widow, to the children; and if there be no children, to the next of kin or legal heirs.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the absence of a nominee the credit balance and contributory call shall be paid to the widow; if there be no widow, to the children; and if there be no children, to the next of kin or legal heirs."
